item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 7 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7-Final #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 03 September 2026(Thursday)

Light to moderate rains was observed over Zambales for the past 3 hours. With this development all RAINFALL WARNING in this area is now terminated.Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Metro Manila, Laguna, Quezon(Infanta, Real, General Nakar) and Batangas(San Jose, Alitagtag, Santa Teresita, San Luis, Cuenca, Agoncillo, Balayan, Balete, Calaca, Calatagan, Tanauan, Laurel, Lemery, Lian, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Nasugbu, San Nicolas, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Tuy, Lipa, Bauan, Mabini, Tingloy, San Pascual) within the next 3 hours.
